We present a privacy-preserving data analytics system that leverages state-of-the-art differential privacy techniques and other privacy safeguards to enable the use of LinkedIn member data to power marketing analytics applications.

(i) we provide a system that provides user-level privacy and can be used with a real-time data analytics system; (ii) the system is able to provide a strict differential privacy privacy budget on the results; (iii) the system can be used to provide insights into audience engagement; (iv) the system can scale to handle billions of rows of data.

how to use the latest privacy preserving research to provide a privacy system at scale.
the design, development, and deployment of a privacy preserving analytics system for audience engagement insights at scale.
the problem of providing a differentially private system that can be used by analysts to perform audience engagement analytics on large-scale datasets.
